name: Hops
notes: Hops sits in Params > Util. The Get ... / Context ... components ship with Grasshopper itself (there is one Get component per data type, e.g. Get Number, Get String, Get Point, Get Geometry). Hops inputs and outputs are dynamic, so wire them after the Path is set.
components: Calls a Grasshopper definition (.gh file, URL or REST endpoint) as a function. Inputs and outputs appear once its Path is set (right-click > Path, or right-click > Show Input: Path).
Function input (number). Its name becomes the Hops input name.
Function input (text). Its name becomes the Hops input name.
Function output. The name of its input becomes the Hops output name.
Function output (text). The name of its input becomes the Hops output name.
